_comment: Bihar STET Paper 2 CS format: 150 questions, 2.5 hours. Add your actual questions below.
instructions: 150 questions | 2.5 hours | 1 mark each | No negative marking

questions.question: Which topology provides the highest redundancy?
questions.explanation: Full Mesh topology में हर node बाकी सभी nodes से directly connected होता है, इसलिए यह highest redundancy provide करता है।

questions.question: HTTP runs on which port by default?
questions.explanation: HTTP default port 80 पर run करता है। HTTPS port 443, FTP port 21, SMTP port 25 use करता है।
